4 اودح He confessed; syn. أَقَرَّ: (L, K:) or he confessed a falsehood, or what was false: (ISk, T, K:) or he confessed himself submissive to him who would lead, guide, or govern, him: (AZ, T, K:) he was submissive, or prompt in obedience, and humble. (S, K.) ―
-b2- He (a ram) held back, and would not mount the female. (S, K.) ―
-b3- اودحت الإِبِلُ The camels became fat and in good condition. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
